activity_summary: At Shipston a woman offered bread under a cloth. You heard your own vowel in her mouth. She would not make a ceremony of it. You did not buy a speech.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the vowel and did not make a scene of coming home.

facets.activity: Heard the same vowel at Shipston

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That is my own vowel. I had forgotten the shape of it.
